questions.why: The text says he admits and corrects mistakes.

questions.q: How does the master view competition, per the text?
a: As a playful way to improve together
As a battle to dominate opponents
As a chance to prove superiority

questions.why: He treats self‑interest as one vote, not the only one.

questions.q: What is the master's attitude toward death?
a: He accepts it and does not fear it
He tries to avoid it at all costs
He sees it as a failure
He believes it can be postponed
